item.title: Iran's Araghchi meets Omani counterpart in Muscat
item.description:
Iran's Araghchi meets Omani counterpart in Muscat

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has met his Omani counterpart in the capital of Muscat.

"A constructive meeting today with my colleague @araghchi," Omani foreign minister Badr Albusaidi wrote in a post on X. "We reviewed the steady course of Oman–Iran relations and practical ways to deepen cooperation between our two countries."

"We also exchanged views on the latest diplomatic efforts underway to address regional challenges, and reaffirmed the importance of continued dialogue and consultation in support of de-escalation and peaceful solutions."

item.title: Russia, Saudi Arabia and Australia named as biggest CO2 exporters in history
item.description:
Analysis of fossil fuel exports since 1850 differs from most assessments – which look at countries where CO2 is released

Russia, Saudi Arabia and Australia are the three biggest exporters of carbon dioxide in history, according to analysis of fossil fuels since 1850.

Russia tops the list of global exporters of fossil fuels, with its vast coal, oil and gas deposits. Accounting for the CO2 produced by burning these exports, Russia has been responsible for more than 70 gigatonnes, up to the end of 2025.

item.title: Vance says war on Iran will not become a long-term commitment
item.description:
Vance says war on Iran will not become a long-term commitment

US Vice President JD Vance has indicated that the war on Iran will not last for year.

"The Iranian nuclear program is a threat to the United States of America," he said in an interview with Fox News. "But we are not gonna allow this to become a 10 or 15 year commitment or frankly, even a two-year commitment.”

"We’re not gonna stay there forever, we promised we wouldn’t and I have full confidence the president will get us out of this thing with great results."

item.title: Tanker transiting Strait of Hormuz attacked near Oman: UKMTO
item.description:
Tanker transiting Strait of Hormuz attacked near Oman: UKMTO

A tanker transiting the Strait of Hormuz was attacked seven nautical miles north of Khasab, Oman, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) said on Monday.

Citing a third-party agency, UKMTO said that the attack disabled the vessel and caused fire in the engine room. The crew was reported safe.

The extent of the damage is not known yet.

item.description:
The US president oscillates between strike threats on Iran and insisting the war ‘militarily is effectively over’

A third US aircraft carrier has arrived in the Middle East, US Central Command said in a social media post on Monday, making a dramatic show of military might as Donald Trump keeps his options open for next steps in the Iran war.

The USS Theodore Roosevelt brings thousands of additional troops to the Middle East as Trump has oscillated between threatening additional large-scale strikes on Iran and insisting that the more than eight-month-old war “militarily is effectively over”.

item.title: Saudi Arabia strategy challenged by anti-Houthi forces in Yemen
item.description:
Accusations of incompetence follow retreat of Riyadh-backed forces in effort to relieve siege of Taiz and protect Aden

Saudi Arabia has been accused by anti-Houthi forces over its military strategy after its Yemeni allies withdrew troops from the strategic Bab al-Mandab strait and pulled back forces from parts of Marib in the central part of the country.

The Saudi-backed government explained the repositioning by saying the strategic priority was to break the attritional siege on Taiz, Yemen’s third city, and to protect Aden, the southern port city in which the Saudi-backed and UN-recognised government is now based.
